propositions: JiraDataCenterBackend does not satisfy the Backend protocol because it lacks query_project and assert_env_ready implementations, causing isinstance checks to return False
The reconciler.backend configuration validator rejects 'jira-datacenter' at load time even though the backend is registered and factory-resolvable, leaving it unreachable via config
Inbound identity minting for DC-shaped assignees (name/key identifiers without accountId) silently never occurs due to an early guard, whereas Cloud creates ghost identities
The TicketTransport protocol declares six members but the core code calls set_entity_property from three sites, creating a latent completeness defect in the port contract
The DC backend must map its vendor identifier to the shared 'jira' creation channel to preserve the epic's shared-identity vocabulary and prevent per-deployment fragmentation
